lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
integration_giphy-adminSettings: 31,439 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite-plugin-css-injected-by-js 30,563 B, generated by vite 591 B, generated by @vitejs/plugin-vue2 226 B.
integration_giphy-personalSettings: 4,269 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite-plugin-css-injected-by-js 4,142 B, generated by @vitejs/plugin-vue2 127 B.
integration_giphy-referenceGif: 41,850 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite-plugin-css-injected-by-js 40,287 B, generated by vite 1,504 B, generated by rollup 46 B.
All 3 pages load the same 1 file: 479,856 B raw, 127,825 B gzip, 75.3 % of the smallest page (integration_giphy-referenceGif, 637,264 B).
Inside: generated by vite 71,220 B, axios 65,248 B, node-gettext 52,693 B, generated by vite-plugin-css-injected-by-js 25,866 B, focus-trap 17,761 B.
262,532 B in 589 pieces of 8 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (28 packages, 69 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
